messages.subject: Tag div question
parts:
Notice that I can't really do something like this in UI within WithTags:

div(data-spy = "affix", data-offset-top = "190", class = "col-lg-3 affix", "my text goes here")

but I can run this (the only difference removing dashes from data-spy and data-offset-top):

div(dataspy = "affix", dataoffsettop = "190", class = "col-lg-3 affix", "my text goes here")

Is there a trick to work around this issue? Currently the only option I see is use HTML function.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Tag div question
parts: You can put single quotes, double quotes, or backticks (`) around the names.
